rules.recovered: T1, T4 and T8 read healthy, and the best T10 sample is at least 4 Mbit (half the diamond). A 7.5 vs 8.09 reading is not a failure.
rules.valid_fixes: DO_NOTHING alone if traffic is fine unchanged; else each remediation that recovered; else ESCALATE
rules.different_fixes: the two valid fix sets share no action
rules.inseparable: different fixes and no matrix test differs; expected action ESCALATE
